name: Kubernetes Community Days New York 2027
tagline: New York's cloud native community is coming back together.
description: Kubernetes Community Days New York is a community-organized, CNCF-supported event bringing together adopters, contributors and technologists from the open source and cloud native ecosystem across New York City and beyond. Dates, venue, call for proposals, sponsorship and registration for 2027 will be announced here.

newsletter.title: Get KCD New York updates
newsletter.text: Be the first to hear when the date is locked in, the call for proposals opens and tickets go on sale. No spam, unsubscribe any time.

previousEdition.name: KCD New York 2026
previousEdition.summary: On June 10, 2026 the cloud native community filled Convene One Liberty Plaza for our third edition. A full day of keynotes, technical sessions and hallway conversations, all under the banner of Building Bridges in Cloud Native.
